Täsmälleen vähintään 1 vuoden käytännön kokemusta käsisammuttimien tarkastus- ja huoltotöistä.

Voimassa olevaa Tukesin hyväksymää käsisammuttimen huoltajan pätevyyttä (valmius toimia liikkeen vastuullisena hoitajana).

Tolkun asennetta – olet nälkäinen tekijä, joka nauttii matkustamisesta ja haluaa ottaa vastuun laajasta valtakunnallisesta kokonaisuudesta.

Erinomaista matkustusvalmiutta ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta vaihtuvissa kohteissa.

title: Oracle Fusion Data Migration Lead
description:
Oracle Fusion Data Migration Lead


Key Responsibilities

1. Data Migration Planning and Cycle Leadership

  • Own and drive the data migration workstream across mock migrations, testing cycles, cutover rehearsals and production migration.
  • Create and maintain detailed data migration plans covering extraction, mapping, transformation, file preparation, load, validation, reconciliation, defect resolution and rework.
  • Define migration milestones, dependencies, entry/exit criteria, ownership and delivery checkpoints for each data object.
  • Track migration progress, risks, data defects, decisions and actions, escalating issues that could impact the wider implementation plan.
  • Coordinate with programme, customer, functional, technical, testing and business teams while retaining direct ownership of migration delivery.

2. Customer Extraction Requirements and Legacy Data Analysis

  • Work closely with customer data/extraction teams to define the exact data required from the legacy system for each Oracle Fusion object.
  • Translate Oracle Fusion functional and technical requirements into clear legacy extraction specifications, including required fields, selection criteria, effective dating, historical data rules, filters, defaults and valid values.
  • Review customer-generated extracts for completeness, structure, data quality and fitness for migration before transformation and load activities begin.
  • Analyse source data to identify duplicates, missing mandatory values, invalid dates, broken relationships, inconsistent codes, referential integrity issues and other migration risks.
  • Provide actionable feedback to the customer on extraction issues and support iterative correction of source extracts.

3. Legacy-to-Fusion Mapping and Migration Design

  • Create, maintain and mature mapping documents that establish field-level and value-level mappings between legacy systems and Oracle Fusion.
  • Document source fields, Fusion target attributes, transformation rules, defaulting logic, lookup/value mappings, effective-date handling, derivation logic and business rules.
  • Work with HCM and Payroll functional consultants to confirm target configuration, mandatory attributes, business rules, reference data and downstream dependencies.
  • Ensure changes agreed during migration cycles, defect resolution or functional design discussions are reflected in migration mapping and transformation documentation.
  • Identify gaps where legacy data cannot directly support Fusion requirements and define pragmatic transformation, cleansing or defaulting approaches with the relevant stakeholders.

4. Hands-on Data Preparation, Transformation and Oracle Fusion Loading

  • Prepare Oracle Fusion migration templates and load-ready files from customer-provided legacy extracts.
  • Perform data manipulation, transformation, enrichment, formatting and validation using SQL, Excel and other suitable analytical or data-processing tools.
  • Create and execute HCM Data Loader (HDL) files and, where appropriate, HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL) or other Oracle-supported loading mechanisms.
  • Manage load sequencing and dependencies between related HCM and Payroll objects to ensure data is loaded in the correct order.
  • Execute loads in Oracle Fusion, review load status and logs, identify failed records, investigate root causes, correct data or file structures and perform re-loads until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved.
  • Differentiate between source-data, mapping, transformation, configuration, environment and load-mechanism issues and route or resolve them appropriately.
  • Provide clear technical and business justification for rejected or failed records and recommend the required corrective action.

5. Reconciliation, Validation and Data Quality Assurance

  • Develop, modify and execute reconciliation reports comparing source data, prepared migration files and successfully loaded Oracle Fusion data.
  • Use SQL and Oracle Fusion reporting tools such as BI Publisher and OTBI to validate migrated data and identify variances.
  • Create object-level validation reports covering record counts, key totals, critical attributes, balances, relationships and other business-significant measures.
  • Perform detailed analytical review of migration results rather than relying only on load success percentages.
  • Investigate reconciliation differences, identify root causes and drive corrective action through source correction, transformation changes, configuration updates or reload.
  • Support business validation by supplying clear reports, exception lists, evidence and explanations that enable customer sign-off.

6. Functional, Business and Technical Collaboration

  • Partner with Oracle Fusion HCM and Payroll functional consultants to understand configuration, statutory/legislative requirements, functional dependencies and object-specific migration requirements.
  • Translate functional requirements into data requirements that customer extraction teams can understand and implement.
  • Work directly with business users to clarify legacy data meaning, validate transformation assumptions and resolve data exceptions.
  • Collaborate with reporting, integration, security and technical teams where migrated data affects downstream processes or reconciliation.
  • Act as the primary data migration point of contact for assigned HCM/Payroll areas and provide confident, evidence-based updates to stakeholders.

7. Migration Governance and Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain clear auditability of migration rules, mapping decisions, file versions, load results, reconciliation evidence and outstanding exceptions.
  • Establish repeatable migration processes, templates, checklists and quality controls across migration cycles.
  • Perform root-cause analysis on recurring migration issues and introduce preventative controls for subsequent cycles.
  • Support cutover planning by defining final extraction windows, load sequence, estimated processing activities, reconciliation steps and business sign-off requirements.
  • Contribute to migration closure reporting, lessons learned and transition of migration knowledge into support or BAU teams where required.

Key Deliverables

Deliverable

Expected Outcome


Data Migration Plan

Object-level plan covering extraction, transformation, load, validation, reconciliation, defects, rework and sign-off.

Mapping Documents

Field/value mapping and business-rule documentation between legacy source data and Oracle Fusion.

Extraction Requirements

Clear customer-facing specifications defining the shape, content, criteria and history required from source systems.

Fusion Load Files

Validated HDL/HSDL or other Oracle-supported migration files prepared in the required load sequence.

Load & Error Analysis

Load logs, exception tracking, root-cause analysis, corrections and evidence of successful reload.

Reconciliation Reports

Source-to-file-to-Fusion reconciliation including counts, key attributes, totals and exception analysis.

Validation Evidence

Business-readable validation outputs and supporting evidence for migration acceptance/sign-off.

Cycle Status & Closure

Progress reporting, risks/issues, migration metrics, outstanding exceptions and closure/lessons-learned outputs.

Required Technical Skills and Knowledge

  • Strong hands-on experience delivering Oracle Fusion HCM and/or Payroll data migration activities.

title: Co-Founder & CTO
description:
About the Role

This is a true co-founder seat — not a conventional CTO hire. You will join a pre-seed AI video advertising and martech startup at the ground floor as an equal co-founder with ~28% equity ownership, taking full authority over the research agenda, the product, and the technical team.

The company operates an AI-powered platform that connects brands with a large network of AI video creators, enabling high-volume, performance-driven ad creation at speed and scale. The flywheel is already turning — nearly 10,000 creators on the platform, brands actively running campaigns — and the incoming technical co-founder will decide how the company's core AI advantage is built from here. Several of the most consequential technical and product decisions are deliberately still open, waiting for the right person to make them.

The company is backed by experienced founders and operators with deep roots in consumer tech, gaming, and venture, and has closed a pre-seed round.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full technical vision and research agenda as an equal co-founder — this is your roadmap to shape, not someone else's to execute

  • Architect and build the company's core AI/ML technical advantage across video generation, creative intelligence, and platform infrastructure

  • Make high-stakes, still-open product and system design decisions with real authority and accountability

  • Recruit, lead, and grow the engineering and research team

  • Partner with the other co-founder(s) on company strategy, fundraising narrative, and investor relationships

  • Drive the evolution of a multi-sided AI creator marketplace — spanning brand tooling, creator workflows, campaign management, and AI model development

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Exceptional technical depth — you can credibly lead both applied AI/ML research and production engineering

  • Demonstrated ability to make independent, high-impact technical and product decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Prior experience building or leading engineering teams; comfortable being the first or most senior technical voice in the room

  • Full-time commitment — this role is 6–7 days per week, in person in San Francisco

  • Genuine co-founder mindset: you want ownership, accountability, and the upside that comes with both

Nice to Have

  • Background in generative AI, video generation, or creative/media technology

  • Experience at an early-stage startup (seed or pre-seed) in a technical leadership role

  • Familiarity with ad tech, marketing technology, or creator economy platforms

title: Pricing Architect
description:
About the Role

We're a small, fast-moving team building an AI-native pricing platform that helps B2B SaaS companies transform pricing from a static exercise into a continuously improving, data-driven system. Our platform spans the full pricing lifecycle — from willingness-to-pay analysis and packaging design through to deal execution and sales coaching.

As a Pricing Architect, you'll be a cornerstone of our customer-facing practice. You'll own pricing engagements end-to-end — from initial discovery through to live pricing models and ongoing optimisation — acting as a trusted advisor to commercial and executive stakeholders. You'll also work closely with our product and engineering teams, using the platform daily and feeding back sharp, specific insights that shape our AI recommendations and product roadmap.

This is a high-ownership, high-impact role at an early-stage company. You'll help build the playbook that scales.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end pricing engagements — from discovery and alignment workshops through to live pricing model delivery and post-go-live optimisation.

  • Design segmentation, packaging, price metrics, discounting structures, and monetisation logic tailored to each customer's business.

  • Lead market research and run workshops with customers independently, influencing stakeholders up to C-level.

  • Act as a trusted pricing advisor, setting expectations, aligning on value, and proving commercial impact.

  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and convert them into upsells.

  • Use the AI pricing platform daily to solve real customer problems and give continuous, specific product feedback to improve AI recommendations.

  • Partner with product and engineering to sharpen the pricing engine and tooling.

  • Support rollout and change management, including onboarding sales teams to improve execution quality.

  • Document learnings and help build a repeatable, scalable Pricing Architect methodology.

  • Participate in sales pitches and help advance deals by identifying and qualifying prospects.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 5–7+ years in pricing, commercial strategy, or revenue management — with a background in Tier-1 strategy consulting and/or pricing/monetisation roles in tech or SaaS.

  • Deep expertise in pricing fundamentals: segmentation, packaging, price metrics, discounting, and willingness-to-pay methodologies.

  • Proven track record of leading end-to-end pricing engagements from concept to live model, with full ownership of multiple engagements.

  • Hands-on use of GenAI/LLM tools in day-to-day pricing work today — you're already integrating these into your workflow.

  • Proficiency with data analysis using spreadsheets and SQL to support and validate pricing decisions.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to influence C-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience coaching or mentoring others in pricing or related commercial functions.

  • Demonstrated comfort thriving in fast-paced, high-ambiguity startup environments.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $180,000–$220,000 per year

  • Meaningful equity through an ESOP

  • Market-competitive benefits package

  • Visa sponsorship: Not available

Location

This is an on-site role based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Candidates must be based in Amsterdam or willing to relocate. The team also has a presence in San Francisco, CA.

We are seeking an experienced Civil Engineer Project Manager to lead the development, integration, and delivery of innovative civil construction solutions for large-scale, complex projects.


This role requires a strong foundation in civil engineering and a deep understanding of how civil construction activities are planned, sequenced, and executed in the field. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between engineering requirements, construction operations, and emerging automation technologies to ensure that individual solutions can be successfully integrated into a complete and executable civil works approach.


This position is particularly well suited for a Civil Engineer Project Manager who understands the practical realities of earthwork, excavation, grading, trenching, utilities, site development, and heavy civil operations and can translate those requirements into defined operational and technical solutions.


Experience with construction automation, robotics, autonomous equipment, or material-handling systems is preferred.


What You'll Do:


Civil Engineering & Construction Integration

  • Serve as the civil engineering subject matter expert responsible for defining how civil construction activities should be executed and integrated.
  • Develop practical civil work solutions based on project requirements, field conditions, construction methodologies, and available equipment capabilities.
  • Define the appropriate sequence of civil construction operations, including excavation, grading, trenching, earthmoving, material movement, and related site activities.
  • Evaluate whether proposed equipment and technology solutions can meet actual construction requirements, including production expectations, operating limitations, excavation depths, grading tolerances, site constraints, and other field requirements.
  • Identify gaps between technical capabilities and construction needs and work with internal and external teams to develop practical solutions.
  • Ensure solutions are designed around real-world construction requirements rather than individual equipment capabilities alone.

Solution Development & Integration

  • Coordinate the integration of multiple construction technologies, equipment platforms, and operational processes into a complete civil works solution.
  • Define operational interfaces and dependencies between individual equipment and technology solutions.
  • Ensure individual solutions work together in the correct construction sequence and collectively support overall project objectives.
  • Partner with engineering, product, technology, operations, construction, and external solution providers to translate field requirements into clear technical and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate technical solutions from the perspective of constructability, field execution, productivity, and scalability.
  • Support the development of repeatable civil construction solutions that can be applied across multiple projects and environments rather than being limited to a single site.

Project & Delivery Management

  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, schedules, deliverables, and implementation strategies.
  • Track the development and delivery timelines of individual equipment, automation, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate dependencies between multiple workstreams and ensure required solutions are delivered in the appropriate sequence.
  • Identify schedule, technical, operational, and integration risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies.
  • Lead cross-functional meetings to review progress, resolve issues, and maintain alignment between engineering, technology, construction, and operations teams.
  • Provide clear reporting on project status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and solution readiness.
  • Ensure that technical development remains aligned with field deployment requirements and construction schedules.

Field Validation & Constructability

  • Validate that developed solutions meet the operational requirements of the civil construction environment.
  • Work closely with construction and field teams to understand workflow, equipment utilization, production requirements, and site constraints.
  • Participate in field testing, demonstrations, pilots, and solution validation activities.
  • Evaluate solution performance and recommend improvements based on actual field results.
  • Support development of construction methodologies, workflows, and operating procedures associated with new technologies.
  • Ensure solutions can be safely and effectively incorporated into existing construction operations.

Automation & Emerging Technology

  • Support the evaluation and deployment of automation technologies within civil construction workflows.
  • Collaborate with technology partners developing autonomous or semi-autonomous construction equipment and related systems.
  • Help translate traditional construction processes into workflows that can be supported by automated equipment and technology.
  • Evaluate equipment and automation capabilities against actual construction requirements and identify operational limitations or development needs.
  • Support integration of multiple automated or technology-enabled systems into coordinated construction operations.

title: Špecialista pre technický predaj
description:
VEĽKÉ PROJEKTY / TECHNICKÉ RIEŠENIA / TÍM, O KTORÝ SA MÔŽETE OPRIEŤ

V rodine KNAUF nestaviame len z kvalitných stavebných materiálov. Staviame na odbornosti, dôvere a spolupráci. Do nášho technického tímu hľadáme nového kolegu alebo kolegyňu na pozíciu

ŠPECIALISTA PRE TECHNICKÝ PREDAJ

Knauf je synonymom pre príležitosť. Vieme, že príležitosť sa pre každého javí inak a sme hrdí na to, že ju vidíme v každom.

Táto pozícia spoločnosti Knauf by pre Vás mohla byť perfektnou príležitosťou na vybudovanie jedinečnej kariéry v kultúre založenej na hodnotách s jasným cieľom urobiť zo zajtrajška domov pre nás všetkých.

Ako skupina sme globálnym výrobcom stavebných materiálov a našich 41 500 členov tímu v 90 krajinách na 300 pobočkách poskytuje obrovskú príležitosť pre každého s ambíciami a energiou. Vážime si príspevok každého rovnako a prajeme si, aby ste do práce priniesli celé svoje ja, aby ste ďalej obohatili podnikanie, pretože spoločne dosahujeme viac v bezpečnom a inkluzívnom prostredí.

Koho hľadáme?

Máte skúsenosti zo stavebníctva, technického poradenstva alebo projektovania.

Ste technologický nadšenec, ktorého baví hľadať riešenia a komunikovať s ľuďmi.

To najdôležitejšie je, aby ste mali technické znalosti a myslenie, chuť učiť sa a záujem rozvíjať sa v oblasti moderného stavebníctva.

Produkty, systémy a know-how Knauf vás naučíme.

Máte za sebou skúsený tím odborníkov, ktorí roky pomáhajú zákazníkom riešiť technické výzvy na slovenských stavbách.

Čo budete robiť?

Nebudete sedieť celý deň za počítačom.

Budete prepájať techniku, stavebné projekty a komunikáciu s ľuďmi.

• Navrhovať (aj zložité a detailné) technické riešenia pre zákazníkov a stavebné projekty.
• Pomáhať projektantom, realizačným firmám a investorom vyberať správne systémy a produkty.
• Poskytovať odborné technické poradenstvo a podporu obchodnému tímu.
• Zúčastňovať sa na významných stavebných projektoch po celom Slovensku.
• Viesť technické prezentácie, školenia a odborné konzultácie.
• Spolupracovať s kolegami z predaja, marketingu a technického oddelenia.

Každý deň je iný.

Raz riešite technický detail projektu, druhý deň prezentujete riešenie architektovi a tretí deň ste priamo na stavbe, kde pomáhate zákazníkovi nájsť najlepšie riešenie.

Čo očakávame?

Hľadáme človeka, ktorý rád premýšľa nad technickými súvislosťami a zároveň dokáže komunikovať s ľuďmi.

  • Kľúčové je technické alebo stavebné vzdelanie (VŠ technickeho alebo stavebneho zamerenia)

  • Rozumiete technickej dokumentácii, materiálom alebo stavebným procesom.

  • Baví vás nachádzať riešenia a pomáhať zákazníkom.

  • Dokážete komunikovať technické informácie zrozumiteľne a prakticky.

  • Chcete sa ďalej rozvíjať a získavať nové odborné znalosti.

Výhodou bude skúsenosť zo stavebníctva, technického predaja, projektovania alebo technického poradenstva. Nie je to však jediná cesta k úspechu.

Prečo práve KNAUF?

• Sme stabilná medzinárodná spoločnosť s rodinnou firemnou kultúrou.
• Na trhu pôsobíme desaťročia a patríme medzi technologických lídrov v stavebníctve.
• Máme unikátne know-how a silné produktové portfólio.
• Investujeme do vzdelávania a rozvoja našich ľudí.
• V začiatkoch vás nenecháme samých – budete mať podporu skúsených kolegov a odborníkov.
• Budete pracovať na projektoch, ktoré reálne menia podobu slovenského stavebníctva.

Čo vám ponúkame?

• Základnú mzdu od 2 100 € brutto mesačne (v závislosti od skúseností).
• Výkonnostný bonus.

title: Data Insights Analyst
description:
Data Insights Analyst

Contract - 6 months

Theale/Home – 3 days a week in the office, 2 from home


We’re looking for a Data Insights Analyst to turn data into meaningful commercial and operational insight.

You’ll be responsible for gathering and analysing data from multiple sources to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce costs, optimise resources and drive commercial performance.


This is a role for someone who can go beyond reporting — using data to understand what is happening, why it is happening, what it means financially, and what the business should do next.


Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, integrate and validate data from multiple systems and sources to create reliable datasets.
  • Analyse data to identify trends, inefficiencies, waste and opportunities for cost reduction and margin improvement.
  • Quantify the financial and operational impact of identified opportunities.
  • Identify resource inefficiencies and recommend practical actions to improve performance.
  • Develop clear, insight-led reports, dashboards and visualisations to support business decision-making.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to understand processes, challenges and improvement opportunities.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support the implementation of process and system improvements driven by data insights.


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an analytical and commercially minded individual who can combine strong data analysis with practical business thinking.


You’ll need to be comfortable working with multiple data sources, identifying patterns and opportunities, communicating findings clearly, and turning analysis into measurable business improvements.


If you enjoy asking “what does the data tell us, why does it matter, and what should we do about it?”, this could be an excellent opportunity.

title: Process Engineer, Maritsa Plant - 05.2026

description:
Chceš se jednou stát vedoucím prodejny? Jsi připravený/á zajistit, aby byl sklad prodejny JYSK vždy perfektně zorganizovaný? Lákají tě různorodé úkoly a práci v maloobchodě máš spojenou s poskytováním skvělého zákaznického servisu? Prokaž své odhodlání a využij příležitost ke kariérnímu a profesnímu růstu! V JYSKu si zakládáme na silných týmech a skvělé spolupráci - společně překonáváme cíle a neustále zlepšujeme věci k lepšímu.

CO TI NABÍZÍME:

  • Férovou firemní kulturu s jasně definovanými hodnotami, které nás spojují.
  • Příležitosti k osobnímu, profesnímu a kariérnímu růstu - 80 % našich manažerů začínalo jako asistenti prodeje.
  • Atraktivní měsíční bonus za skvělé prodejní výsledky.
  • Prodejní tým, na který se můžete spolehnout, a společenské akce, které vám umožní poznat kolegy z celé republiky.
  • Flexibilní pracovní dobu s pracovním úvazkem 37,5 hodin/týdně, abyste mohli sladit práci, rodinu a volný čas.
  • 5 týdnů dovolené
  • Slevu 20 % na produkty JYSK.
  • Zprostředkování karty MultiSport.
  • Mimořádné finanční odměny za doporučení zaměstnance až do výše 20 000 Kč.
  • Pravidelné soutěže s atraktivními peněžními odměnami, či dárkovými kartami
  • Mzda: 42 000 Kč brutto + měsíční bonusy podle výkonu prodejny.

O ČEM BUDE TVOJE PRÁCE:

  • Práce se zbožím: koordinuješ objednávání, příjem, naskladňování a doplňování zboží na prodejní ploše tak, aby byl celý sortiment vždy dostupný.
  • Obsluha zákazníků: dbáš na to, aby zákazníci měli z nakupování skvělý zážitek.
  • Péče o prodejnu: udržuješ prodejnu v čistotě a pořádku, aby se v ní zákazníci cítili příjemně.
  • Školení a vedení: školíš a zapojuješ kolegy do práce ve skladu a zodpovídáš za bezpečnost práce.

Hledáme člověka, který je:

  • orientovaný na zákazníka a dokáže dosáhnout skvělých prodejních výsledků.
  • otevřený a přátelský, přirozeně komunikuje a vytváří příjemnou atmosféru i při fyzické práci ve skladu.
  • proaktivní a energický, vždy se chopí příležitosti a přispívá k úspěchu týmu.
  • íky svému strukturovanému přístupu dokáže koordinovat kolegy při plnění úkolů.

JE JYSK TVOU NOVOU PŘÍLEŽITOSTÍ? Přihlas se ještě dnes!

Rádi vám poradíme nebo pomůžeme. Stačí nám poslat e-mail na adresu evy/chsi@jysk.com.

Výběrové řízení:

Přijaté životopisy zpracováváme průběžně a nábor ukončíme , když najdeme toho pravého kandidáta. Vždy provádíme pohovory a na vybrané pozice zasíláme uchazečům videodotazníky, osobnostní dotazníky a dotazníky kognitivních funkcí. Zajímá nás, co vás motivuje k tomu, abyste se stali našimi kolegy na dané pozici.

Zjistěte, jak zpracováváme Vaše údaje v našich [Zásadách ochrany osobních údajů].

O NÁS

Věříme, že naši zaměstnanci jsou klíčem k našemu úspěchu. Proto se snažíme v rámci naší společnosti nabízet rozvoj,možnosti růstu a hledání nových výzev v rámci společnosti JYSK. Od roku 1979, kdy náš zakladatel Lars Larsen otevřel svou první prodejnu v Dánsku, rozšířil JYSK globální působnost o prodejny a internetové obchody v zemích po celém světě.

Naše tři základní hodnoty JYSK - Kupec, Kolega a Kultura firmy - vyjadřují chování a přístup, který můžeme očekávat jeden od druhého. Navzájem si důvěřujeme, věříme ve zmocnění a svobodu s odpovědností. Jsme také hrdí na to, že odměňujeme angažovanost a velké úsilí našich zaměstnanců. Se správným přístupem je v JYSKu velké množství příležitostí.

Pro více informací prosím navštiv naši kariérní stránku.

title: AI & Backend Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're a seed-stage B2B SaaS company building an AI-powered support agent designed for technical, complex customer service workflows. Our product helps B2B teams auto-resolve difficult support tickets, equips human agents with AI-driven context and suggestions, and bridges the gap between support and engineering — all within a secure, compliance-first architecture.

We're looking for an AI & Backend Engineer to join our small, high-velocity team. You'll own end-to-end features across the full stack, shape AI-powered capabilities, and help scale the architectures that power our agents. This is a high-impact role at an early stage where your work will directly define the product.

Tech stack: Python, FastAPI, OpenAI models (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, o3, o4-mini), Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Firestore (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement full-stack product features from concept to production.

  • Develop and enhance AI features, including LLM pipelines, prompt engineering, and agent architectures.

  • Collaborate with the team to plan, design, and ship new capabilities at pace.

  • Help make internal workflows AI-native — actively experimenting with AI coding agents and tooling to improve team productivity.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 1–4 years of experience in backend or AI engineering (new graduates with strong AI project experience are welcome).

  • Demonstrated ability to build and ship backend systems or AI pipelines to production.

  • Hands-on experience integrating OpenAI models and crafting effective prompts.

  • At least some experience working with AI agents (e.g. autonomous task agents, LLM-powered workflows).

  • Experience designing end-to-end architectures and building AI-powered data or model pipelines.

  • Proficiency with Next.js, React, and TypeScript for full-stack development.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and/or Firestore (GCP).

  • Experience deploying and operating applications with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Hobby projects involving LLMs or related AI topics — we want to see genuine curiosity and self-driven exploration.

  • Eligibility to work in Germany (visa sponsorship is available).

  • Availability to work on-site in Munich, 5 days a week.

Nice to have:

  • Heavy user of AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor — with concrete learnings or ideas about improving AI-assisted development setups.

  • Background in B2B SaaS, customer support tooling, or developer tooling.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment (comparable to companies like Sierra, Intercom, Freshworks, Forethought, or similar).

Location

This role is fully on-site in Munich, Germany, 5 days per week. Visa sponsorship is available for eligible candidates.

title: Director, Team Security
description:
Senior Director Team Security

Location: New York City, NY; Tarrytown, NY

Department: Standard Hiring

Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (MSG Sports) is a leading professional sports company, with a collection of assets that includes the New York Knicks (NBA) and the New York Rangers (NHL), as well as two development league teams – the Westchester Knicks (NBAGL) and the Hartford Wolf Pack (AHL). MSG Sports also operates a professional sports team performance center – the MSG Training Center in Greenburgh, NY. More information is available at www.msgsports.com.

Who are we hiring?

The Senior Director Team Security for The New York Knicks will be accountable for developing and implementing proactive/preventative security measures and programs for the protection of MSG’s team personnel, players and family members both domestically and on a global basis as needed. This position will also support MSG’s business continuity and crisis management efforts. This position will be responsible for the execution of player-specific needs and appearances, in accordance with existing team and Madison Square Garden policies, guidelines and initiatives.

What will you do?

  • Develop and maintain a best-in-class security program for the NY Knicks, ensuring team personnel and players are always protected.
  • In partnership with MSG’s Intelligence and Investigation team, conduct investigations involving game incidents that involve players, staff and others as necessary and directed.
  • Travel with team throughout the course of the season (preseason, regular season and playoffs) and provide personal player security (ingress, egress, post-game, etc.) for all games at MSG and road games, working in tandem with team security and other related MSG personnel.
  • Participate in the security planning and on-site management of security at selected special events including the NBA, All-Star Games, Global Games, Drafts, Playoffs, and other special events.
  • Coordinate, prepare and disseminate all relative information regarding player security to appropriate team personnel / executives and appropriate in-house staff (MSG/Command Center, etc.).
  • Interact and coordinate efforts with all necessary team personnel and MSG staff on game nights.
  • Provide personal security for family members as directed.
  • Ensure the highest level of guest experience, while providing a secure environment, in all areas where the potential public/player interaction may exist.
  • Responsible for communicating all relative information regarding player security to team executives and MSG staff on game nights – including those posts near the team locker rooms and related additional areas restricted to non-club personnel.
  • Confer and provide information regarding operational and investigative situations when necessary.
  • Will work closely with the Director of Event Operations, Director of Building Security, Director of MSG Intelligence and the Director of Investigations to coordinate player activities when applicable.
  • Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site.

What do you need to succeed?

  • 12+ years of related experience
  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of security operations and management experience with a knowledge of events and/or sports operations.
  • Ability to develop and execute company and departmental standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and effectively articulate and manage security budgetary initiatives.
  • Strong background and experience in emergency planning/business continuity.
  • The ability to effectively provide close supervision, guidance, and structure to staff as needed.
  • Proven ability to assess, develop and successfully execute strategic internal and external security plans and quickly adapt to change as required by events.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication; organizational and time management skills are required.
  • Must have the ability to work independently and use sound business judgment while displaying tact, diplomacy and a commitment to company values.
  • Adept at maintaining a positive, open, approachable, and professional relationship with a diverse group of people.
  • Highly responsive to emergencies.
  • Experience working with law enforcement and coordinating security and safety needs for clients.
  • Specialized training in safety and security for high profile clients.
  • Demonstrate the ability to make sound decisions without detailed instruction

Special Requirements:

  • Position requires substantial travel year-round. Candidates will be expected to be able to travel often and endure long periods of standing and sitting with little to no notice.
  • Work hours are often fluid and not considered “normal’ work hours while traveling during the season.
  • Candidates are required to be extremely flexible as travel plans are susceptible to delays and changes to accommodate team needs.

title: Eye Technician
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

Provides assistance, technical support and services to Ophthalmologists including taking patient medical histories, administrating diagnostic tests, assisting during treatment and surgical procedures while acquiring on the job training for the COA certification.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. High school diploma or equivalent.

2. Ophthalmic Assistant Certification obtained through JCAHPO within one (1) year of hire date.

3. Obtain certification in Basic Life Support within 30 days of hire date.

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Escorts patients to exam rooms.

2. Obtains and records accurate patient histories to include chief complaint, present ocular status, ocular history, and family history, past and present medical history, medications and allergies.

3. Obtains and records accurate visual acuity of adult, children and infant patients.

4. Performs Visual Field Testing, basic lensometry and keratometry.

5. Measures and records spectacle prescriptions both manually and with automated equipment

6. Performs basic ocular motility testing and record results.

7. Measures and compares basic pupil assessments.

8. Tests intraocular pressure with applanation tonometer and tonopen.

9. Performs and record slit lamp exam

10. Cleans and sterilizes ophthalmic instruments and maintain ophthalmic equipment.

11. Stocks examination rooms with supplies on a daily basis, maintain clinic inventory, and ensure working order of equipment.

12. Maintains universal precautions

13. Moves equipment to other testing areas of the clinic or hospital

14. Participates in educational instruction and independent study in preparation for COA Certification

15. Under the supervision of the provider, or certified technician, may perform more advance patient testing and advanced skills in order to obtain sufficient on the job training to meet the qualifications needed to acquire the COA certification required at one year of service.

16. Certification eligible testing assistants may administer topical ocular medications

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Work requires strength and /or stamina, lifting, moving, stooping, reaching, standing for long intervals ,frequent walking, and carrying materials or pushing equipment weighing 40 + lbs.

2. Vision correctable to at least 20/30 in one eye.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Normal clinical environment. May be exposed to biohazards and communicable disease.

2. The incumbent will work in the presence of ophthalmic lasers frequently and be required to wear protective eye equipment.

3. May work with blood, lab specimens, and other patient bodily fluids that require universal precautions.

4. Travel to offsite clinics may be required

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

1. The ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a high volume clinic

2. Ability to operate ophthalmic equipment and computers.

3. Analytical skills are desirable to complete the technical aspects of patient examinations.

title: Founding AI Engineer
description:
About the Role

A fast-growing, AI-first consumer social platform is hiring a Founding AI Engineer to join its core team in San Francisco. The company uses AI agents to facilitate real-world, in-person social connections — organizing curated small-group hangouts for young people, with a growing presence across university campuses in the US. The platform operates entirely through AI: matching, logistics, reminders, follow-ups, and continuous learning, all without a traditional app.

As a founding engineer, you will own two mission-critical pillars of the product and have an outsized impact on the direction of the technology.

What You'll Do

AI Matching & Social Graphs

  • Build a new type of social graph grounded in real-world interaction data

  • Match people into highly compatible groups and surface patterns that drive meaningful friendships

  • Work with millions of data points using collaborative filtering and graph intelligence

  • Develop and iterate on embeddings, ranking systems, and large-scale personalization

  • Apply reinforcement learning informed by real-world outcomes

Communication Workflows & AI Agent Experience

  • Design and build AI agent experiences across channels where users already are (e.g. Instagram, iMessage, WhatsApp, TikTok)

  • Orchestrate multi-channel agent workflows connecting APIs, third-party services, and the database layer

  • Build scalable infrastructure to support complex, multi-step AI workflows

  • Own human-AI interaction design for a seamless, natural user experience

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 4–10+ years of experience building AI/ML systems in production

  • Comfort working across the full stack — from data pipelines to user-facing agent interactions

  • Familiarity with multi-channel messaging APIs and agent frameworks

  • Founding mindset: you ship fast, own problems end-to-end, and thrive in ambiguity

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with recommendation systems, social graphs, or large-scale personalization

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $150,000 – $200,000 USD annually

  • Equity: Meaningful founding-level equity

  • Early-stage opportunity with significant upside in a growing consumer tech company

Note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Location

This is a full-time, on-site role based in San Francisco, California. The team works together in person.

They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

11. Recognizes strategies to improve nursing quality.

12. Provides critical review and/or evaluation of policies, procedures, and guidelines to improve quality of healthcare.

13. Demonstrates understanding of importance of data collection and utilization.

14. Disseminates educational findings, experiences, and ideas with peers.

15. Engages in activities related to nurse sensitive indicators to enhance quality of care.

16. Participates in continuing professional development.

17. Identifies ethical situations and seeks assistance of appropriate colleagues.

18. Identifies ways to maintain and improve ethical environment of the work setting conducive to safe, quality health care.

19. Adheres to the moral and legal rights of patients.

20. Engages in opportunities for work/life balance.

1. Completion of annual required education related to specialty accreditation as defined by accreditation standards. Training may be completed through CBLs, trainings, In-services, and competency validation.

All transfers, lifts and re-positioning will be completed utilizing the lift equipment and/or other patient handling aids as indicated by the patient’s profile and appropriate algorithms.

3. Working around infectious diseases.

1. Possesses the interpersonal skills to positively and effectively communicate, negotiate, and resolve conflict.

2. Uses competent clinical practice and critical thinking skills to efficiently deliver patient care with all health care providers while maximizing efficient use of resources.

3. Ability to be flexible in response to changes in work volume, staff and scheduling changes.

4. Ability to work successfully under highly stressful conditions and capable of adapting to varying workloads and work assignments on a constant basis.

The CAPE program is a system-wide clinical advancement program (clinical ladder) to enhance professional development, provide a reward system for quality clinical performance, promote quality nursing, and improve job satisfaction for inpatient direct care nurses.

To apply for the next level, the CAPE nurse must meet the requirements of their current level. They must also meet the required years of nursing experience, degree, and certification to apply for the next level. In addition, nurses who are approved for levels 3, 4, 5, or 6 must complete and submit five competencies on an annual basis to maintain their current level.

Level 1

  • No experience required
  • All graduate nurses with less than 12 months of experience enter at Level one with a diploma, ADN, BSN, or higher

Level 2

  • Meets requirements for previous level
  • One year of experience.

Level 3

  • Meets requirements for previous levels
  • Two years of experience, plus one specialty certification
  • Certification is Preferred but not required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students

Level 4

  • Available to those with a BSN or higher or nurses with ADN/diploma with 5 years of experience
  • one specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and/or shared governance at the unit level

Level 5

  • Available to those with an MSN or higher with 4 years of experience, or nurses with a BSN with 4 years of experience and a health-related Master’s Degree, or nurses with a BSN and 5 years of experience
  • One specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and shared governance at the organization level

Level 6

  • Available to those with an MSN or higher degree with 7 or more years of experience. Consideration is given to other health-related advanced degrees that would assist with direct patient care at the bedside
  • One specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and shared governance at the system level

title: Programme Coordinator
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

MINDS has been caring for Persons with Intellectual Disabilities (PWIDs) and their families since 1962.

Grounded in the belief that all PWIDs have innate abilities and talents, MINDS is committed to empowering them and enhancing their quality of life, while advocating for greater inclusivity for PWIDs as a nation.

MINDS is today one of the largest charities in Singapore employing more than 1200 staff. With the key focus to expand community-based services, improving the employability of PWIDS, strengthening education, and engendering inclusive community living, MINDS offers a holistic range of services and programmes across the PWIDs' lifespan.

These include schools, employment and training development centres, home-based care services and community-based services to cater to the physical, psychological, environmental and social needs of PWIDs. For more information, please visit www.minds.org.sg.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Programme Coordinator assists the Manager in overseeing the Appropriate Adults Programme for Persons with MentalDisabilities (AAPMD) Scheme. The AAPMD Scheme seeks to support persons with intellectual disabilities, autism spectrumdisorders (ASD), or mental health conditions by facilitating their interviews with relevant law enforcement agencies.The Programme Coordinator plays a key role in ensuring programme effectiveness, service quality, and stakeholderengagement through programme coordination, volunteer management, and outreach efforts.A resourceful, proactive, and client-focused professional, the Programme Coordinator works across community,institutional, and voluntary welfare settings to support programme delivery.

1. Programme & Call Centre Coordination

  • Oversee the Call Centre's operations to ensure effective support for the AAPMD programme.
  • Monitor service quality, compliance and staff performance, and implement improvements where needed.
  • Analyse operational data and provide regular updates and recommendations to the Manager.

2. Volunteer Recruitment & Development

  • Coordinate volunteer recruitment and screen prospective volunteers to build a strong pool of active volunteers.
  • Develop and conduct training to equip volunteers with the knowledge, skills and standards required for the programme.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, guidance and support to strengthen volunteer capability and effectiveness.

3. Volunteer Management & Engagement

  • Manage volunteer policies, processes, records and training requirements, ensuring compliance across programmes.
  • Identify volunteer needs and gaps, implement risk management measures, and address volunteer concerns promptly.
  • Drive volunteer engagement, recognition and reactivation initiatives to strengthen retention and long-term participation.

4. Stakeholder & Community Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with social service organisations, community partners, corporate partners and government agencies.
  • Coordinate with external organisations and stakeholders to support programme delivery and volunteer recruitment.
  • Conduct outreach activities and support community engagement plans to raise awareness and strengthen the volunteer network.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Diploma/Degree preferably in social work or related-fields with 1- 2 years working experience.
  • Social Service sector / programme management experience will be an advantage.
OTHER INFORMATION
  • Willingness to be hands-on with strong communication and good interpersonal skills.
  • Empathetic and have a strong Interest towards understanding and serving Persons with Intellectual Disability and their caregivers.
  • Self-driven and a team player.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Must be prepared to respond to programme needs outside of regular work hours when required
  • Have a strong sense of urgency and responsibility
  • Experience in working with persons with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities or related field is preferred

title: Tårnby Kommune søger en erfaren ingeniør/ projektleder til trafik, vej og anlæg
description:
Erfaren ingeniør/projektleder til trafik, vej og anlæg

Vil du være med til at udvikle trafiksikkerhed, mobilitet og vejprojekter i en kommune i vækst?

Vi søger en erfaren ingeniør eller trafikplanlægger, der har lyst til at blive en del af Trafik, Vej og Grønne Byrum og tage selvstændigt ansvar for både trafikfaglige opgaver og konkrete vej- og anlægsprojekter.

Du bliver en del af vejteamet med 7 kolleger i en afdeling med i alt ca. 14 medarbejdere. Her får du en bred opgaveportefølje, hvor trafik, trafiksikkerhed og mobilitet kombineres med projektledelse af større og mindre vej- og anlægsprojekter.

Tårnby Kommune er i vækst, både befolkningsmæssigt og i forhold til den grønne omstilling. Det medfører et højt aktivitetsniveau med trafiksikkerhedsprojekter, vejudvidelser, byggemodninger, arealudvikling samt anlæg, drift og vedligeholdelse af kommunens infrastruktur.

Stillingen er derfor til dig, der både finder det spændende at arbejde analytisk og strategisk med trafikområdet og samtidig ønsker at omsætte fagligheden til konkrete løsninger og projekter ude på kommunens veje.

En stilling med bred faglig spændvidde

Som vores nye kollega kommer du til at arbejde på tværs af trafik-, vej- og anlægsområdet.

På trafikområdet vil du blandt andet arbejde med trafiksikkerhed, trafikplanlægning, uheldsanalyser, skoleveje, signalanlæg samt udvikling af kommunens trafik- og cykelplanlægning.

Samtidig får du ansvar for konkrete vej- og anlægsprojekter, hvor du som projektleder og bygherrerepræsentant følger projekterne fra de første overvejelser og projektering til udbud, udførelse og aflevering.

De to områder hænger tæt sammen. Trafikfaglige analyser og politiske prioriteringer skal ofte omsættes til konkrete fysiske løsninger. Her får du mulighed for både at være med til at identificere behovet, udvikle løsningen og efterfølgende drive projektet frem mod realisering.

Stillingen rummer en bred opgaveportefølje, men det betyder ikke, at du skal arbejde med alle områder på samme tid. Opgaverne vil variere over tid, og i perioder vil tyngden eksempelvis ligge på trafik og trafiksikkerhed, mens der i andre perioder vil være større fokus på projektledelse og konkrete vej- og anlægsprojekter.

Prioriteringen vil ske i dialog med afdelingslederen og med afsæt i aktuelle projekter, politiske prioriteringer og afdelingens samlede opgaver. Du skal derfor trives med en alsidig hverdag, hvor fokus kan skifte, samtidig med at du har ansvar for at skabe fremdrift og kvalitet i de opgaver og projekter, du arbejder med.

Dine opgaver

Du får en varieret hverdag med både selvstændigt ansvar og tæt samarbejde med kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

På trafik- og trafiksikkerhedsområdet vil dine opgaver blandt andet være:

  • trafiksikkerhed, herunder konkrete projekter og indsatser
  • uheldsstedfæstelse og uheldsanalyser
  • trafikplanlægning og mobilitet
  • trafiksikkerhed omkring skoler
  • signalanlæg og øvrige trafiktekniske problemstillinger
  • revision og udvikling af kommunens trafikhandlingsplan og cykelhandlingsplan
  • trafikfaglige vurderinger og behandling af borgerhenvendelser
  • udarbejdelse af faglige oplæg og politiske sager.

På vej- og anlægsområdet vil du blandt andet arbejde med:

  • projektledelse af større og mindre vej-, trafik- og anlægsprojekter
  • at drive projekter fra idé og projektering til udbud, udførelse og aflevering
  • bygherrefunktion og styring af eksterne rådgivere og entreprenører
  • styring og opfølgning på økonomi, tidsplan, kvalitet og risici
  • udbudsprocesser og leverandørkontakt
  • koordinering med forsyningsselskaber og øvrige interessenter
  • samarbejde med kommunens egen driftsorganisation om anlægs- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver
  • dialog med borgere, virksomheder og øvrige interessenter i forbindelse med projekterne.

Du vil desuden indgå i den løbende opgaveløsning i vejteamet og bidrage med faglig sparring og videndeling. Opgaverne kan variere i takt med kommunens projekter og politiske prioriteringer.

Vi søger en erfaren profil

Du har en relevant teknisk eller trafikfaglig uddannelse, eksempelvis som ingeniør, trafikplanlægger eller tilsvarende, og du har flere års relevant erhvervserfaring inden for vej-, trafik- eller anlægsområdet.

Vi søger en kollega, der har den faglige ballast til relativt hurtigt at kunne tage selvstændigt ansvar for egne opgaver og projekter.

Du har erfaring med trafik, trafiksikkerhed, vej eller anlæg og har arbejdet med projektledelse eller gennemførelse af konkrete projekter. Det vil være en fordel, hvis din erfaring spænder over flere af områderne.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis komme fra en kommune. Erfaring fra en rådgivende ingeniørvirksomhed, entreprenør, forsyningsvirksomhed eller anden relevant organisation kan være lige så interessant.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du
  • har solid faglig erfaring inden for vej-, trafik- eller anlægsområdet
  • har erfaring med projektledelse og kan drive projekter fremad
  • arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket over flere samtidige opgaver og projekter
  • tager ejerskab og følger dine opgaver og projekter til dørs
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og træffe fagligt velfunderede beslutninger
  • har blik for både helheden og de detaljer, der kan påvirke projektets økonomi, tid og kvalitet
  • arbejder aktivt med fremdrift og risici og kan identificere udfordringer, inden de udvikler sig
  • kan stå fast på dine faglige vurderinger og samtidig være løsningsorienteret
  • kommunikerer klart og professionelt i både skrift og tale
  • kan skabe gode og konstruktive relationer til kolleger, rådgivere, entreprenører, forsyningsselskaber, borgere og virksomheder
  • trives i en politisk styret organisation, hvor opgaver og prioriteringer kan ændre sig.

Erfaring fra en kommune eller anden politisk styret organisation er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Kendskab til relevante fagsystemer som Vejman, SBSYS og WebGIS er ligeledes en fordel.

Om os og hvad vi tilbyder

Trafik, Vej og Grønne Byrum er en del af Center for By, Miljø og Klima.

Vi arbejder bredt med kommunens vej- og trafikområde. Opgaverne spænder fra trafikplanlægning, trafiksikkerhed og vejmyndighed til planlægning og gennemførelse af anlægsprojekter samt drift og vedligeholdelse af kommunens veje, stier, fortove og byrum.

Vi har mange projekter i gang og står over for flere spændende og udfordrende opgaver i de kommende år.

Som en del af Trafik, Vej og Grønne Byrum har vi desuden vores egen driftsorganisation, Materialegården, med ca. 60 dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, som hver dag arbejder med at holde kommunens grønne, grå, sorte og blå områder rene, pæne og attraktive.

Det giver os et tæt samspil mellem planlægning, projektering, anlæg og den efterfølgende drift. Som projektleder vil du derfor også få en tæt kontakt til kollegerne i driften.

Vi lægger vægt på en høj faglig standard, en struktureret tilgang til opgaveløsningen og et velfungerende samarbejde på tværs af fagområder og med eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Hos os får du et job med mening og mulighed for at sætte et synligt aftryk på udviklingen af kommunens infrastruktur. Trafik, mobilitet og vejområdet har stor politisk bevågenhed, og du kommer derfor til at arbejde tæt på både beslutningerne og den konkrete gennemførelse.

Du får selvstændigt ansvar for egne projekter, men står ikke alene. Du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor vi sparrer med hinanden, deler viden og bruger hinandens forskellige kompetencer.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • en fast stilling på 37 timer om ugen
  • selvstændigt ansvar for egne opgaver og projekter
  • mulighed for at arbejde med både trafik, trafiksikkerhed, vej og anlæg
  • større og mindre projekter, som du kan følge fra idé til udførelse
  • en bred kontaktflade på tværs af kommunen og til eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • fleksibel arbejdstid og mulighed for distancearbejde efter nærmere aftale
  • mulighed for reel indflydelse på udviklingen af kommunens vej- og trafikområde.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst med IDA efter forhandling. Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt.

Kommunens ansættelsespolitik indebærer, at der ved ansættelse indhentes referencer fra tidligere og nuværende arbejdssteder. Har du været ansat i Tårnby Kommune, vil der altid blive taget reference herfra. Der skal desuden ved ansættelse forevises straffeattest. Ansættelsen vil være betinget af, at disse er tilfredsstillende.

Jobbet forudsætter desuden et gyldigt eksamensbevis, hvorfor vi beder dig uploade dette ifm. ansøgningen.

Tårnby Kommune tilbyder en række personalegoder. Disse kan ses her.

Tårnby Kommune har et værdigrundlag, som du kan læse her.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at Tårnby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
Job Details:

About the Role

Constellation Payments is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Risk Analyst to support merchant risk monitoring, transaction review, bank account change controls, and ongoing portfolio risk oversight. This role is responsible for identifying and mitigating emerging fraud, compliance, transaction, chargeback, ACH, NACHA, website, MCC, and merchant behavior risks across both new and existing merchants.

The ideal candidate is proactive, analytical, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities, workloads, risk trends, and business needs continuously evolve. They are comfortable managing multiple investigations simultaneously, making sound risk-based decisions, and taking ownership of issues through to resolution. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to adapt quickly to changing processes and priorities, and a willingness to take initiative beyond day-to-day responsibilities.

The Risk Analyst will work closely with Risk leadership, Underwriting, Onboarding, Merchant Support, Finance, Compliance, and external partners to ensure risk items are identified, investigated, documented, escalated, and resolved in a timely and consistent manner. This role plays a critical part in strengthening post-boarding controls, protecting the merchant portfolio, supporting regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement across risk operations.

This position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a growing organization, contributing to the development of risk programs, monitoring frameworks, operational controls, and strategic initiatives while supporting the evolving needs of the business.


Compensation & Role Details:

Expected Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is between $55,000 to 62,000 CAD, depending on experience and qualifications

Role Type: New Role

AI Disclosure: AI may be used during the hiring process.


What You’ll Do

  • Monitor merchant activity for fraud, compliance, reputational, operational, ACH, chargeback, and transaction-related risks, investigating flagged activity including held transactions, large tickets, refunds, duplicate transactions, excessive authorizations/declines, suspicious processing behavior, and emerging risk trends.
  • Conduct merchant risk reviews and maintain complete case documentation, investigations, outreach, escalations, follow-ups, and resolution records within Salesforce.
  • Manage bank account change reviews, including validation, verification, approvals, system updates, quality control, and ongoing post-change monitoring for suspicious activity, refunds, returns, chargebacks, and other elevated risk indicators.
  • Support ongoing merchant monitoring programs, including website reviews, LegitScript screenings, alert investigations, negative media reviews, sanctions screening, regulatory concerns, prohibited activity reviews, and escalation of significant findings.
  • Perform enhanced due diligence and monitoring for high-risk industries, MCCs, NEC classifications, non-profits, firearms/ammunition merchants, and other restricted or sensitive business categories.
  • Monitor chargeback, ACH, and NACHA-related activity, including return rates, unauthorized and administrative returns, recurring payment activity, threshold monitoring, trend analysis, and remediation efforts with merchants, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Support periodic KYC/KYB refreshes, merchant portfolio reviews, and documentation validation to ensure ongoing compliance and business model alignment.
  • Maintain risk monitoring logs, investigation records, reporting dashboards, and tracking tools while preparing recurring reports on monitoring activity, escalations, investigations, high-risk merchants, and emerging portfolio trends.
  • Document investigations clearly and objectively, including findings, evidence, risk assessments, decisions, ownership, and recommended next steps, escalating critical fraud, compliance, sanctions, regulatory, or operational risks to leadership as required.
  • Support risk process improvements, reporting enhancements, underwriting initiatives, and other operational projects while performing additional duties assigned by leadership to support evolving business needs.
  • Operate effectively in a rapidly changing environment, adapting to shifting priorities, workloads, procedures, risk controls, regulatory requirements, and business initiatives.
  • Take ownership of new responsibilities, support cross-functional projects, and perform miscellaneous duties assigned by management to meet evolving organizational needs.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in risk operations, underwriting, payment operations, fraud monitoring, banking operations, compliance operations, or a similar role.
  • Working understanding of payment processing workflows, merchant accounts, transaction monitoring, chargebacks, ACH returns, refunds, and risk flags.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to validate documentation, identify inconsistencies, and maintain accurate case notes and trackers.
  • Ability to manage multiple open reviews, follow-ups, escalations, and time-sensitive cases at once.
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with partners, merchants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Comfort working with CRM/case management tools, spreadsheets, and operational trackers.
  • Ability to follow documented procedures while identifying gaps, control weaknesses, or opportunities for process improvement.
  • Sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion when handling sensitive merchant, banking, fraud, and compliance information.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Risk, Underwriting, Onboarding, Merchant Support, Finance, Product, and partner-facing teams.
  • Working knowledge of ACH processing, NACHA Operating Rules, ACH return codes, unauthorized return thresholds, administrative returns, and ACH risk monitoring best practices.
  • Ability to review and investigate ACH-related risk indicators, including unusual return activity, account validation concerns, transaction anomalies, and merchant processing trends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in merchant acquiring, PayFac operations, fintech, payment risk, card-not-present environments, or payment gateway operations.
  • Familiarity with Payrix, Salesforce, Zift, Vantiv IQ, LegitScript, GIACT, Inscribe, or similar risk and verification tools.
  • Experience reviewing bank change documentation, voided checks, bank letters, authorized signers, ownership matches, or account verification controls.
  • Experience reviewing chargebacks, ACH returns, transaction holds, duplicate transactions, excessive refunds, or large-ticket verification workflows.
  • Knowledge of MCC risk classification, high-risk industries, NEC classifications, prohibited merchant categories, and enhanced due diligence triggers.
  • Experience preparing risk reporting, KPI summaries, audit support documentation, or operational leadership updates.
  • Comfort working in a remote-first environment with strong follow-through, documentation discipline, and queue ownership.
  • Experience working with ACH risk monitoring programs, NACHA compliance requirements, return rate management, and payment network rules.

Key Success Measures

  • Risk queues, held transactions, bank changes, alerts, and follow-ups are reviewed consistently and within expected operating cadence.
  • Cases and monitoring logs are accurate, complete, and updated with clear next steps, owner, and status.
  • High-risk, critical, or suspicious activity is escalated promptly with supporting detail.
  • Bank account changes are validated, QC’d, documented, and monitored after completion.
  • Risk reporting is delivered clearly, with trends, open items, and recommended follow-ups visible to leadership.
  • Process gaps are identified and translated into practical improvements, templates, or workflow updates.
  • ACH activity and return thresholds are monitored proactively, with risks identified, documented, and escalated before reaching compliance or network reporting concerns.

Work Location & Flexibility

Constellation Payments operates on a 100% remote-first model, enabling team members to work from home or any approved location within the hiring country.


Additional Requirements

Required ability to travel periodically for team meetings (2-3x per year), training sessions, conferences, and other business-related activities as required.

Equal Opportunity & Legal Disclosures

Constellation Payments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

This role does not offer visa sponsorship; applicants must have pre-existing authorization to work in the Canada.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

title: Senior Privacy Counsel
description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is an AI-native cybersecurity company. We use behavioral AI to stop the attacks that get past everything else, and our products depend on processing data responsibly, at scale, across a growing set of global jurisdictions. We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel to own significant portions of our global privacy program — the legal judgment, the day-to-day operational execution and oversight, and the AI-enabled tooling that ties the two together.

This is a senior privacy role, reporting to and operating under the direction of the AGC, PPIP. You will advise product and engineering on building privacy into an AI-native platform, support AI governance from the legal and privacy side, provide product-privacy legal counseling alongside the Director, Legal (Product), and partner with the Privacy Manager, who handles much of the operational execution, to run the day-to-day privacy program (DSARs, assessments, ROPA, notices, audits). You will help build and operate the AI automation, working with Legal Ops and other internal teams, that makes the program scale, and serve as a privacy voice with customers via commercial legal.

We want someone with the expertise, drive, and assertiveness to own initiatives and drive them to completion with limited oversight — as comfortable writing a lawful-basis analysis as they are shipping a workflow that automates it.

Why Join Us

  • Help build and scale the privacy function at a category-defining, AI-native cybersecurity company.
  • Build, not just advise, with real license to design AI automation that changes how privacy work gets done.
  • Work at the intersection of privacy, AI governance, product counseling, and security, on problems that are genuinely new.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and equity, and a clear path to grow the role toward greater program ownership as the program scales.

What You Will Do

  • Global privacy program execution. Support the design of, and drive implementation and continuous improvement of Abnormal's global privacy program, partnering with applicable stakeholders on strategy, policies, standards, and controls, across GDPR/UK GDPR, EU AI Act, NIS2, DORA, EU Data Act, US state privacy laws, and other applicable international frameworks. Advise and execute on the international data transfer strategy (SCCs, UK IDTA, EU–US Data Privacy Framework, transfer impact assessments) as data flows and product footprint expand across jurisdictions.
  • AI governance execution. Drive the day-to-day execution of the AI governance program from the legal and privacy side, including EU AI Act classification and related obligations, seeing initiatives through to completion in partnership with R&D, Security, and AI governance stakeholders.
  • Privacy by Design for AI products and product counseling. Partner with the Privacy Manager and R&D to embed privacy into the design of new AI-driven features, including model data governance, secondary data-use analysis, and the privacy implications of behavioral AI. Set privacy diligence standards for AI/LLM vendors and model providers. Partner with the Director Legal, Product to provide ongoing product and privacy legal counseling to R&D for product and feature development.
  • Privacy operations. Partner with the Privacy Manager to help oversee the privacy operations program — DSARs and data-subject rights, Records of Processing Activities and data mapping, impact assessments (DPIA/PIA/TIA/LIA), retention, consent and cookie management, and audit support (SOC 2, ISO 27701/42001). Contribute to privacy governance forums, as appropriate.
  • Build and operate AI automation. Use AI to make the privacy program scale. Design, deploy, and improve AI-enabled privacy workflows (e.g., DPIA triage and drafting, subprocessor determination) with Legal Operations and engineering. A build-it role, not just a use-it one — specify, prototype, and iterate, holding tooling to a high accuracy and human-review bar.
  • Legal & Regulatory Horizon Scanning. Monitors emerging legal and regulatory developments, including privacy and AI regulation, in current and target expansion markets; flagging jurisdiction-specific requirements to the AGC, PPIP to inform market entry or launch decisions, and translates confirmed guidance into execution support for R&D (product and privacy considerations) and GTM (contracting posture, customer requirements).
  • Vendor, subprocessor, and customer contracts (escalation point). Serve as the privacy subject matter escalation point for the Commercial and Procurement teams on vendor, subprocessor, and customer agreements (DPAs, SCCs, subprocessor terms). Partner with the AGC, PPIP to set the privacy positions and playbook the teams work from.
  • Incident and breach response. Advise on and help lead the privacy and legal aspects of incident response, including AI incidents, breach assessment, notification decisions, and mitigation, working within the company's procedures and regulatory deadlines.
  • Data Protection Officer support & regulatory engagement. Support the DPO function as a day-to-day advisor, conducting first-line assessments, and support delegate-level assessments in line with the company's DPO governance framework. Serve as a privacy contact for supervisory-authority inquiries, customer privacy audits, and security questionnaires. Track developments across the privacy and adjacent-regulatory landscape (e.g., NIS2, DORA, and EU Data Act), and translate regulatory change into concrete program action decisions.

Must Haves

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and member in good standing of at least one U.S. state bar.
  • CIPP/E, CIPP/US certifications
  • 6-8+ years of relevant experience, with strong depth in privacy and data protection law and program execution.
  • Deep, current expertise in European privacy and digital regulation — GDPR/UK GDPR and working familiarity with NIS2, DORA, the EU AI Act, and the EU Data Act — and how they interact for an AI company.
  • Demonstrated experience operating in or advising technology companies, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or cloud, including AI/ML products.
  • Meaningful experience contributing to and helping run a privacy program (beyond pure advisory work) in a fast-moving, global environment.
  • Experience providing product legal counseling alongside privacy.
  • Pragmatic judgment. Starts from the business objective and finds the compliant path, offering options and conditions rather than a reflexive "no," and earning trust as an enabler, not a gate.
  • Strong drafting and judgment on complex privacy agreements (DPAs, SCCs, subprocessor terms), and the ability to set positions, act as an escalation point for the teams who negotiate them, and flag novel issues for escalation.
  • Sound judgment applied to significant, novel, and ambiguous issues, with accountability for outcomes and escalating direction calls as appropriate, while developing subject-matter credibility internally.
  • The drive and assertiveness to own initiatives and drive them to completion with minimal oversight, and the ability to lead through influence, including to persuade diverse senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex privacy issues to business stakeholders.
  • Fluency with AI tooling and the ability to build and iterate on automation workflows — you have used AI to do real work and can specify, prototype, and refine it, holding it to a high accuracy and human-review standard.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting a DPO, including familiarity with independence and governance expectations.
  • Familiarity with privacy and data protection regimes beyond the EU/US — e.g., LGPD (Brazil), PIPEDA (Canada), APPI (Japan).
  • Experience supporting Works Councils and multi-jurisdiction employee/candidate privacy.
  • Experience with privacy tooling and with AI/LLM-based workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with security and privacy audit frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701/42001).
  • CIPM, CIPT, AIGP certifications

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$199,800—$235,000 USD

AI and our hiring process

These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and identify areas for the interviewer to explore. They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person.

title: Scheduler / Shift Coordinator

Location: Remote – supporting Washington, D.C., USA
