  • Confident, natural and professional telephone manner

  • Comfortable working in a high-volume calling environment (circa 60-100 calls per shift)

  • Strong organisational, prioritisation and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to make sound decisions quickly and remain composed under pressure

  • Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping ability

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and general office systems

  • Ability to communicate professionally with clients, families, Care Professionals and senior management

  • Willingness to work hours aligned with US business requirements

  • Reliable broadband connection and a professional home-working environment if the position is confirmed as remote

HIGHLY ADVANTAGEOUS:

  • Home-care, healthcare or medical scheduling experience

  • Workforce-management or shift-planning experience

  • Experience supporting US customers or businesses

  • BPO, contact-centre or high-volume customer-service experience

  • Experience using scheduling, CRM or workforce-management software

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About the Role

A well-funded, early-stage infrastructure company is hiring 2–3 Founding Engineers to work on the core of a graph-native context and memory platform purpose-built for modern AI workloads. This is not a feature factory role — you will own significant pieces of the platform, including the query engine, storage layer, and graph internals, and make architecture decisions that will shape the product for years to come.

You'll work directly alongside the founding team, with your name on design docs and pull requests in the same week. The team is small, high-conviction, and moves fast — every engineer has direct influence on architecture, roadmap, and culture.

The platform addresses a critical gap in AI infrastructure: giving AI agents persistent, structured, and temporally aware context through a GraphDB built on object storage, with semantic search, git-style temporal versioning, and entity resolution. The company has raised a Seed/Series A round from prominent investors and researchers in the AI space.

What You'll Do

  • Own and ship core infrastructure: query execution, graph storage layer, and distributed systems components

  • Make architecture decisions with long-term product impact alongside the founding team

  • Contribute to benchmark and research work that defines the technical category

  • Participate in architecture reviews and make hard technical trade-offs with real production consequences

  • Help raise the technical ceiling as the engineering team grows

What We're Looking For

Dealbreakers (must-haves):

  • Proficiency in Rust or Go with hands-on experience building distributed systems

  • Experience designing and shipping core infrastructure components — query engine, storage layer, or graph internals — in a production environment

Required:

  • Strong CS fundamentals — you reason from first principles, not just frameworks

  • 3+ years of relevant engineering experience

  • Comfort owning large, ambiguous problems without a predefined playbook

  • Track record of shipping production systems that handle real load for real customers

  • Ownership mindset: ability to contribute meaningfully to design docs and architectural decisions

Nice to have:

  • Experience building or scaling distributed systems, databases, or storage infrastructure

  • Open source contributions in systems-level projects

  • IIT or Recurse Center background

  • Prior founding engineer or early-stage infrastructure role experience

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $160,000 – $270,000 USD annually

  • Equity: Meaningful equity — the team believes builders should own a real piece of what they create

  • Wellness programs and free daily meals in-office

  • Top-tier hardware and software setup

  • Flexible PTO focused on deep, high-impact work

  • Learning budget covering books, courses, conferences, and compute for personal experiments

  • Periodic team offsites

Visa sponsorship: Not available.

Location

This is an on-site role based in San Francisco, CA. The team works together in person, which is core to how they build and collaborate at this stage.

title: Java Developer
description:
Introductie

Bij TenneT werk je aan een energievoorziening die Nederland in beweging houdt. Als Java Developer maak je direct impact op de toekomst van het elektriciteitsnet. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het realiseren van innovatieve en duurzame energieoplossingen. Samen met collega’s werk je aan het ontwerpen, testen, implementeren en onderhouden van oplossingen, processen en tools voor Operate. Je werkt nauw samen aan oplossingen voor collega’s van de control room, zodat Nederland kan blijven rekenen op betrouwbare energie.

Jouw rol

Je komt te werken in een Scrum-team dat al jaren stabiel draait. Het team bestaat uit 7 collega’s. Testen is binnen dit team een gemeenschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid. Elke dinsdag is er een vaste teamdag op kantoor. Het team werkt aan de doorontwikkeling en verbetering van een aantal applicaties binnen een groot en complex applicatielandschap. Hierbij worden Java, Quarkus, REST API’s, Kafka en JPA/Hibernate gebruikt.

Je krijgt binnen het team een zelfstandige functie met veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om zaken samen met het team te regelen. Vanwege de cruciale rol van de applicaties mag je als developer alles in twijfel trekken en betrokkenen zoals ontwikkelaars, architecten en business uitdagen. Creativiteit en initiatief voor nieuwe ideeën worden gewaardeerd.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van robuuste en schaalbare softwareoplossingen. Je werkt zowel aan de backend (Java, REST API’s) als aan de frontend (Angular) en speelt een sleutelrol in het realiseren van end-to-end functionaliteit. Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair Scrumteam waarin iedereen actief bijdraagt aan ontwikkelen, testen en operations. Daarnaast ben je onder andere verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Optreden als technisch expert en vertrouwd adviseur binnen het eigen vakgebied en geven van vakinhoudelijk advies aan interne stakeholders, zoals architecten, ontwikkelaars, testers en product owners.
  • Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van schaalbare backend-services, frontend componenten, RESTful API’s en integraties binnen een event driven en cloud-native architectuur.
  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de technische kwaliteit van softwareontwikkeling en de correcte toepassing van ontwikkelstandaarden en best practices, met gebruik van technologieën als Java, Quarkus, Angular, JPA/Hibernate en Kubernetes.
  • Nauw samenwerken met multidisciplinaire teams en bijdragen aan kennisdeling, coaching en begeleiding op het gebied van softwareontwikkeling, testen, CI/CD en agile werken.
  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van geautomatiseerde testoplossingen en bijdragen aan de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van applicaties door toepassing van tools en technieken zoals JUnit, Mockito, Playwright, Cucumber, Jenkins, Git en SonarQube.
  • Zorgen voor naleving van relevante standaarden, securityrichtlijnen en kwaliteitsnormen binnen het ontwikkelproces, zodat veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen worden gerealiseerd.
  • Analyseren en vertalen van functionele wensen en technische vraagstukken vanuit business, beheer en projecten naar passende technische oplossingen.
  • Ondersteunen van applicaties in productie door het leveren van level 2 support, analyseren van incidenten en identificeren van structurele verbeteringen.
  • Continu evalueren en verbeteren van ontwikkelprocessen, architectuur en technische oplossingen om efficiëntie, kwaliteit en onderhoudbaarheid te verhogen.

Waar kom je terecht

Digital & Technology Transformation (DTT) is de digitale ruggengraat van TenneT. Deze divisie maakt slim gebruik van data, technologie en AI om het net optimaal te benutten en besluitvorming te versterken. DTT levert geïntegreerde en veilige digitale-, technologie- en dataservices die bijdragen aan efficiëntie, innovatie, veiligheid en compliance. De divisie ondersteunt bedrijfsprocessen en werkplekken met IT, ontwikkelt data- en integratieplatformen en beheert de IT-infrastructuur en cybersecurity.

Jouw profiel & achtergrond

Voor deze rol wordt gevraagd dat je de juiste ervaring en vaardigheden meebrengt om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan het team en de missie. Daarom wordt van jou gevraagd:

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Java Developer in enterprise omgevingen.
  • Grondige kennis van Java 21/25, Quarkus, REST API’s en JPA/Hibernate.
  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met recente Angular versies, inclusief component-based development en state management.
  • Ervaring met frontend- en backend-testing frameworks (Playwright, Mockito, Cucumber).
  • Ervaring met CI/CD tools: Jenkins, Git, Maven, SonarQube.
  • Professionele beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Om in deze rol het verschil te maken, herken je je in de volgende competenties:

  • Optimaliseren van werkprocessen.
  • Managen van complexiteit.
  • Kwaliteit van beslissingen.

Deze rol valt binnen het functieprofiel IT specialist.

title: Fulltime NICU RN NIghtshift
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

This position has the authority, responsibility, and shift accountability for the delivery of nursing care through the use of the nursing process. The incumbent accepts accountability, applies competent clinical knowledge skills, and uses independent nursing judgment for care provided by self and by health care providers to whom care is delegated to achieve quality patient care outcomes.

The incumbent must demonstrate the knowledge and skills at the novice level necessary to provide care that is relevant to the patient(s) under their care, as well as apply principles of growth and development over the life span. The incumbent also must possess the ability to assess and interpret patient data needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to his or her age-specific needs. This role provides professional nursing care for patients in an inpatient hospital setting.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Current Registered Nurse license issued by the state in which services will be provided or current multi-state Registered Nurse license through the enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact (eNLC).

2. Obtain certification in Basic Life Support within 30 days of hire date.

EXPERIENCE:

1. Less than 12 months of experience as a registered nurse.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Bachelors of Science in Nursing Degree (BSN).

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Demonstrates safety and continuity of care using methods such as documentation, handoff tools/processes, etc.

2. Demonstrates ability to create plan of care using the nursing process: assessment, diagnoses, intervention, and evaluation of outcomes.

3. Recognizes patient safety concerns through appropriate resources.

4. Provides education based on unique learning needs of patient.

5. Incorporates patient individuality & mutuality data in delivery of care.

6. Performs an adequate patient assessment and documentation.

7. Demonstrates teach-back method to evaluate effectiveness of education.

8. Utilizes Evidence-Based Practice (EBP) in nursing care.

9. Participates in organizational patient-centered care model.

10. Documents problems and issues in the plan of care.

11. Demonstrates growth in ability to care for more complex patients utilizing consultation with experienced colleagues.

12. Demonstrates a commitment to lifelong learning through self-reflection and inquiry for learning and personal growth.

13. Retains accountability for delegated nursing care.

14. Recognizes scope of practice for all interprofessional team members.

15. Participates in holistic, culturally sensitive data collection.

16. Assesses the impact of family dynamics on healthcare consumer health and wellness.

17. Integrates the American Nursing Association (ANA)’s code of ethics to guide nursing practice.

18. Identifies discriminatory health care practices in culturally diverse populations.

19. Individualizes care based on beliefs, barriers, and readiness to learn of patients.

For facilities with specialty accreditation requirements:

1. Completion of annual required education related to specialty accreditation as defined by accreditation standards. Training may be completed through CBLs, trainings, In-services, and competency validation.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. The National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health recommends minimizing the need for employees to manually lift patients, and limit safe patient handling to 35 pounds. All transfers, lifts and re-positioning will be completed utilizing the lift equipment and/or other patient handling aids as indicated by the patient’s profile and appropriate algorithms.

2. Heavy/Hard work: Work requires strength and/or stamina, lifting, moving, stooping, reaching, standing, walking, and carrying of materials and equipment weighing 40+lbs.

3. Visual acuity must be within normal range.

4. Hearing within normal range is required (i.e. to assess breath sounds, bowel sounds, apical pulse, monitors, etc.)

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Working protracted or irregular hours.

2. Working around biohazards.

3. Working around infectious diseases.

4. Working with or near the deceased.

5. Working with hands in water.

6. Working with electrical hazards associated with patient care equipment.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

1. Possesses the interpersonal skills to positively and effectively communicate, negotiate, and resolve conflict.

2. Uses competent clinical practice and critical thinking skills to efficiently deliver patient care with all health care providers while maximizing efficient use of resources.

3. Ability to be flexible in response to changes in work volume, staff and scheduling changes.

4. Ability to work successfully under highly stressful conditions and capable of adapting to varying workloads and work assignments on a constant basis.

The CAPE program is a system-wide clinical advancement program (clinical ladder) to enhance professional development, provide a reward system for quality clinical performance, promote quality nursing, and improve job satisfaction for inpatient direct care nurses.

To apply for the next level, the CAPE nurse must meet the requirements of their current level. They must also meet the required years of nursing experience, degree, and certification to apply for the next level. In addition, nurses who are approved for levels 3, 4, 5, or 6 must complete and submit five competencies on an annual basis to maintain their current level.

Level 1

  • No experience required
  • All graduate nurses with less than 12 months of experience enter at Level one with a diploma, ADN, BSN, or higher

Level 2

  • Meets requirements for previous level
  • One year of experience.

Level 3

  • Meets requirements for previous levels
  • Two years of experience, plus one specialty certification
  • Certification is Preferred but not required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students

Level 4

  • Available to those with a BSN or higher or nurses with ADN/diploma with 5 years of experience
  • one specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and/or shared governance at the unit level

Level 5

  • Available to those with an MSN or higher with 4 years of experience, or nurses with a BSN with 4 years of experience and a health-related Master’s Degree, or nurses with a BSN and 5 years of experience
  • One specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and shared governance at the organization level

Level 6

  • Available to those with an MSN or higher degree with 7 or more years of experience. Consideration is given to other health-related advanced degrees that would assist with direct patient care at the bedside
  • One specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and shared governance at the system level

title: Sr Software Test Engineer, Mobile Automation
description:
TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a talented Sr. Software Test Engineer, Mobile Automation to join our shared Software QA Automation team in Round Rock, Texas.

Summary

The Sr. Mobile Test Automation Engineer will focus on automation coverage for the Smart Mobility platform. This role will primarily own native iOS and Android mobile test automation, including framework development, mobile regression coverage, device-cloud execution, CI/CD integration, and mobile quality reporting. The engineer will validate key Smart Mobility workflows across mobile applications, backend services, cloud services, and downstream transaction systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for native Android and iOS applications.
  • Build reusable automation components, utilities, reporting, test data handling, and execution standards.
  • Automate sanity, functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end mobile test scenarios.
  • Perform testing across real devices, emulators/simulators, OS versions, and cloud device platforms.
  • Analyze automation failures, troubleshoot flaky tests, and continuously improve framework reliability.
  • Ensure mobile apps meet expectations for functionality, usability, reliability, security, and performance.
  • Coordinate with DevOps engineers to integrate mobile smoke, regression, and end-to-end automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirements reviews, and design discussions to identify mobile quality risks early.
  • Support shift-left testing, automation-first delivery, and Test-Driven Development practices.
  • Create dashboards, automation execution reports, and mobile quality metrics for release readiness.
  • Track mobile automation coverage, pass/fail trends, flaky tests, defect leakage, and release risks.
  • Support defect triage, bug fix validation, targeted regression testing, and release sign-off activities.

Requirements and Qualifications
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field required.
  • 8-12 years of QA experience, with strong automation engineering background.
  • 5+ years of hands-on mobile testing experience across iOS and Android.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining mobile automation frameworks from scratch.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile automation tools such as Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Maestro, or similar tools.
  • Experience testing native, hybrid, and mobile web applications.
  • Experience with device cloud platforms such as BrowserStack, SauceLabs, LambdaTest, or similar.
  • Programming experience in Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or C#.
  • Strong knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Agile/Scrum practices, debugging, troubleshooting, and automation best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Playwright test automation for Web UI and API testing.
  • Experience testing tolling, transportation, SaaS, payment, or transaction-based systems.
  • Experience with performance tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar.
  • Exposure to observability, logs, metrics, tracing, crash analytics, mobile performance monitoring, security, and application resiliency.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test acceleration, troubleshooting, and automation productivity.

*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

Physical Demands/Work Environment
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

* TransCore complies with federal and state disability laws and provides reasonable accommodation for employees with disabilities.

title: Enterprise AI Transformation Lead, DACH
description:
About the Role

A fast-growing, Y Combinator–backed enterprise AI platform is hiring an Enterprise AI Transformation Lead to own and scale AI-driven change across the DACH region from Munich. You'll work directly with senior leadership to transform multibillion-euro enterprises into AI-native operators — acting as a trusted strategic partner to C-suite executives, building high-impact agent deployments, and helping grow the regional team as the company expands across Europe.

This is a high-agency, high-ownership role for someone who combines top-tier consulting instincts with deep hands-on AI expertise and the energy of an operator.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the regional rollout across DACH from Munich, owning regional outcomes end-to-end.

  • Serve as the AI transformation partner to CEOs, CIOs, and Chief Transformation Officers at large enterprises.

  • Run each account like a consulting engagement: stakeholder mapping, diagnostic, roadmap, rollout, and measurable outcomes.

  • Diagnose where AI creates the most leverage and identify the highest-value use cases for each customer.

  • Systematically automate your own workflows by building agents and processes that eliminate manual work.

Dealbreakers

  • Native-level German proficiency; based in Munich or fully willing to relocate.

  • 3+ years in enterprise AI transformation consulting, delivering transformation roadmaps and C-suite engagements for large enterprises.

  • Proven hands-on experience shipping production AI agents, including model routing, evaluation design, data residency considerations, and enterprise integration architecture.

Required

  • Tier-one consulting background (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Roland Berger, or equivalent) or equivalent transformation experience delivering enterprise AI programmes.

  • Experience building and deploying agent workflows in enterprise AI platforms or equivalent environments.

Nice to Have

Visa: Sponsorship is not available for this role.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: €90,000 – €150,000 per year, depending on experience.

  • Opportunity to build and lead the DACH regional team from the ground up.

  • Work directly with senior leadership at a well-funded, high-growth AI company.

  • Meaningful ownership and influence over product direction as the primary customer voice.

Location

TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a talented Sr Software QA Engineer, Test Automation to join our shared Software QA Automation team in Round Rock, Texas.

Summary

We are seeking a Sr. QA Test Automation Engineer to join the shared QA Automation team and support automation coverage across the Smart Mobility platform, with primary focus on Web UI automation, API automation, backend validation, cloud/platform testing, integration testing, performance testing, and CI/CD execution. This role will help define scalable automation practices across Smart Mobility solutions and validate end-to-end quality across web portals, services, cloud-native components, and downstream transaction systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for Web UI, API, database validation, and integration testing.
  • Build reusable automation components, utilities, reporting, test data handling, and execution standards.
  • Perform backend data validation, SQL checks, transaction reconciliation, and end-to-end integration validation.
  • Test event-driven, distributed, and cloud-native services across the Smart Mobility platform.
  • Design and execute performance, load, scalability, and reliability tests for cloud-based services.
  • Establish performance baselines for APIs, backend services, and transaction processing.
  • Coordinate with DevOps engineers to integrate API, web, smoke, regression, and integration automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirements reviews, and design discussions to identify quality risks early.
  • Support shift-left testing, automation-first delivery, and Test-Driven Development practices.
  • Create dashboards, automation reports, and quality metrics for release readiness.
  • Track automation coverage, pass/fail trends, defect leakage, flaky tests, performance baselines, and release risks.
  • Support defect triage, bug fix validation, targeted regression testing, UAT, post-release smoke testing, and production validation.
  • Help define automation standards, framework direction, test architecture, and automation best practices across Smart Mobility solutions.

Requirements and Qualifications
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • 8-12 years of QA experience, with strong automation engineering background.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks from scratch.
  • Strong experience with Web UI automation and API automation, preferably using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, REST-assured, Postman/Newman, or similar tools.
  • Experience with backend validation, SQL/data validation, integration testing, and transaction reconciliation.
  • Experience testing event-driven, distributed, or cloud-native applications.
  • Experience with Git, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test execution.
  • Programming experience in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#, or similar languages.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum practices, SDLC, QA methodologies, debugging, troubleshooting, and automation best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Mobile test automation experience across iOS and Android is preferred, including tools such as Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Maestro, or similar.
  • Experience with performance tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar.
  • Exposure to observability, logs, metrics, tracing, crash analytics, security, resiliency, and cloud monitoring.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test acceleration, troubleshooting, and automation productivity

*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

Physical Demands/Work Environment
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

* TransCore complies with federal and state disability laws and provides reasonable accommodation for employees with disabilities.
